name: KCL lead-screw
group: King's College London (Booth, Bergeles; Robertshaw, Jackson, Chen)
versions: Hamlyn Symposium 2025 (Sadati, long CTR in vitro); RA-L 2026 HM-MARL; IROS 2026 world model; arXiv 2026 progressive fusion; arXiv 2607.07253 haptic leader study
target_anatomy: neurovascular: femoral artery to carotid / ICA in printed phantoms of patient CTA
devices_driven: 0.035 in guidewire (180 cm Terumo) + 0.058 in Navien support catheter (125 cm) (towardb); jackson2026: Terumo Glidewire + Penumbra SlipCath Beacon, Penumbra Neuron MAX fixed (Sec. III-B); concentric shafts allow up to three devices (guidewires, microcatheters, stent retrievers; jackson2026 Sec. II-B)
n_dof_detail: 2 per carriage (translation, rotation); 4 with two devices
translation_detail: linear-stage+clamp (carriages on one 1 m, 2 mm-pitch lead screw; telescopic tubes between carriages against buckling)
rotation_detail: hollow-shaft NEMA 17 stepper per carriage with drill-chuck coupling
device_range: two device sizes used; range N.R.
footprint_mm: 1 m lead screw on 20x20 mm aluminium frame; other dimensions N.R.
force_sensing: ATI Mini 58 six-DOF force sensor in the guidewire carriage, proximal axial/lateral/torsional forces at 250 Hz (jackson2026 Sec. II-B, Fig. 2(c)); phantom with eight piezoresistive wall-force sensors (Fig. 3)
haptics_leader: yes in jackson2026_manual: device-mimicking dual-device handle (buttons select catheter, guidewire or both) on MyActuator RMD-L 4015 brushless motors, force reflection at 250 Hz; compared with manual, joystick and haptics-off (Sec. II-A, Fig. 1)
imaging_compat: overhead camera or mobile C-arm (Siemens Cios Spin) tracking; robot and phantom under the mobile C-arm in a mock angiography suite (jackson2026 Fig. 4(a)); no MR claim
validation_detail: in-vitro printed phantoms: 10 episodes per task (HM-MARL), 5 runs per task n=25 (world model), 5 runs per sub-task (progressive); 10 neuroradiologists x 8 runs in the haptic leader study
key_numbers: HM-MARL in vitro right ICA 100% (A12) and 70-80% (A23), left 0%; manual expert 10/10 right, 2/10 left; world model 68% vs SAC 60% in vitro; max 40 mm/s translation, 180 deg/s rotation
sim_model: yes: stEVE / SOFA BeamAdapter patient-specific CTA models (Navien and Terumo wire, E = 47 and 43 MPa) - robertshaw2026_towardb
sim2real_detail: yes: hierarchical multi-agent SAC (RA-L 2026): sim 92-100% single anatomy -> in vitro 100/70-80% right, 0% left; TD-MPC2 world model 58% sim holdout -> 68% bench; progressive fusion 90% sim -> 60/67% bench (the sim-to-real study table, robertshaw2026_towardb read full)
